name: Maya-G-M
note: GLM-5.3 after Maya-M, sized for 7 GPUs (5x RTX 4090 48 GB + 2x A100 40 GB): IQ2_S routed gate/up, IQ3_XXS routed down, IQ3_S down in the first and last four MoE layers (3-6, 74-77); NextN experts Q3_K/Q4_K; router and its bias F32; indexer projections Q8_0, its head-weight projection F32; everything else 2-D Q6_K. With a 256K context its experts fit the 7 cards' pools, so no expert is read from RAM.
